scope: Synthetic intensity-Fourier coefficients at fixed nonzero spatial k; not raw SAR or full speckle

inherited_Block15B.scope: BP12 estimator comparison, not CPHD formation validation
inherited_Block15B.axes: axis0 k_parallel, axis1 k_perpendicular, rad/m; bearing from UTM grid north; not true north

preprocessing.Fourier: historical fftshift(fft2); no padding; same coefficients A/B/C

coherence.threshold_reason: square of original Block12 magnitude threshold 0.3; later 0.25 would map to 0.0625, only reported as sensitivity
coherence.borders: invalid complete 3x3 patches; nonfinite or zero power invalid

selection.power_reference: max mean power in full wavelength band, no phase gate
selection.common_quality: finite nonzero coefficients all looks, complete MSC patch, endpoint MSC>=0.09

methods.A: raw reference OLS with free intercept; references 0,16,31
methods.B: direct consecutive circular objective, uniform pair weights
methods.C: direct circular objective, lags1,2,4,8; equal total weight per class

search.rationale: 80% of pi/max adjacent dt; acquisition-only slow-branch restriction, not proof of absence of faster aliases

validity.circular: unique minimum within cost margin, not boundary, RMS<=0.5

inherited_Block15B.frequency_reporting: s_phi signed only; ocean omega and period not identified; abs(s) only historical reproduction
inherited_Block15B.uncertainty: descriptive; no independent-pair standard errors or confidence intervals

noise.seed_rule: numpy default_rng(SeedSequence([150300,case_id,noise_index,replicate])); full (32,3,3) noise; center reused by all methods
noise.independence: Independent across realizations/cases/noise levels; methods and patch layouts paired within each realization

patch.noise: Independent absolute-variance noise per neighboring bin and time; same noise across layouts
patch.coherence: Use frozen local_msc on explicit first/last 3x3 arrays; do not infer MSC from center series

event.definition: At least one pair of methods both valid, both relative absolute bias>0.1 and signed slopes within 0.02
event.extra_quality: Also report event AND high A R2, event AND high endpoint MSC, and all three jointly; not estimator validity changes

diagnostics.standalone_lag_fits: Noiseless configurations only, lags2/4/8; MC uses per-class residuals of C for lag diagnostics
diagnostics.examples: Fixed s_true=.5 static cases: (ratio,phase_index)=(0,0),(.5,0),(.5,4),(1,4),(2,0); plus first lexicographic noiseless joint event with A_R2>=.97 and proportional_MSC>=.8 if present
diagnostics.corrections: No real correction; no optional temporal-mean experiment beyond analytic unit test

output_precision: Fits and CSV float64; residual archive float32, rounded storage only
